title: 낙동강수계관리위원회규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:19806:20061229:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the National Finance Act) <Presidential Decree No. 19806, December 29, 2006>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on January 1, 2007.
Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.
Article 5 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (14) Omitted.
(15) Part of the Regulations on the Nakdong River Basin Management Committee shall be amended as follows:
In Article 5 (1) 1, "Article 5 of the Framework Act on Fund Management" shall be replaced with "Article 66 of the National Finance Act."
In Article 5 (2), "Article 9 of the Framework Act on Fund Management" shall be replaced with "Article 73 of the National Finance Act."
(16) through (42) Omitted.
Article 6 Omitted.
